payload.reason: The evidence clearly outlines the three layers of the annotation scheme used in the OLID dataset, which are defined as levels A, B, and C.

claims.text: The three layers of the annotation scheme are: Level A (offensive vs not offensive), Level B (type of offense), and Level C (target of the offense).
Level B categorizes the type of offense into targeted (TIN) and untargeted (UNT) insults and threats.
Level C categorizes the targets of insults and threats as individual (IND), group (GRP), and other (OTH).
